name: whole-word

name: text-search
use: Search inside contents rather than titles: search in files, full-text search results.

name: list-filter
use: The filter control on table, list and board views (Notion, Linear); Area's funnel reads as a stronger filter action.

name: git-graph

name: diff

name: repository

name: folder-git
use: A folder under version control, a cloned workspace.

name: folder-code

name: folder-tree

name: folder-input

use: JSON and config files in file lists and attachments.

name: file-warning

name: square-terminal

name: logs

name: pipeline

name: container

name: server-cog

name: database-search

name: database-zap

name: api

name: clock-check

name: search-alert

name: switch-camera

name: eject

name: headphones-off

name: captions-off

name: vibrate
use: Vibrate mode in notification settings.

name: sim-card
